worldcombat.skill.magnetbomb.summary: Launch steel bombs that magnetic pull drags onto the target; a bomb sticks the moment it touches and detonates when its fuse runs out. Once stuck it cannot be shaken off, and a bomb that never sticks falls empty. With a chosen target Cluster piles onto it or Spread divides among a ring; with none the bombs fire along the aim, and one that strikes a block sticks to it on the same fuse.
worldcombat.skill.magnetbomb.use.0: Stick steel bombs to a target then detonate them
worldcombat.skill.magnetbomb.use.1: Seed a ring of enemies with bombs at once
worldcombat.skill.magnetbomb.use.2: Force a target to react before the fuse ends
worldcombat.skill.magnetbomb.description: All bombs together deal about %1$s physical damage, split into %2$s bombs stuck to the target; each bomb counts its own fuse and detonates when it expires, with defence, type matchup and crit settled at detonation.
A bomb detonates %1$s s after it sticks, with a %2$s block blast radius; other enemies inside take 45%% of that bomb's damage as splash.
Magnetic pull turns %1$s degrees per tick, locking targets within %2$s blocks at %3$s blocks/tick; a bomb that never sticks falls empty.

With no entity chosen the bombs scatter along the aim and never auto-lock the nearest enemy; a bomb that strikes a block becomes a stationary charge on the impact point with the same fuse and splash, and one that never sticks dissipates empty.
worldcombat.skill.magnetbomb.cluster.on: Cluster: every bomb piles onto the chosen target for heavier single damage; windup is 2 ticks longer.
worldcombat.skill.magnetbomb.cluster.off: Spread: bombs are dealt in turn to every enemy in range for wider coverage, but each single target gets a smaller share than Cluster.
worldcombat.skill.magnetbomb.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s s then costs %4$s PP, recover %3$s s, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.magnetbomb.growth.0: At level %1$s: total power %2$s and %3$s bombs.
worldcombat.skill.magnetbomb.growth.1: At level %1$s: total power %2$s and fuse %3$s s.
On (Cluster): every bomb piles onto the chosen target for heavier single damage, but windup is 2 ticks longer and coverage is small. Off (Spread): bombs are dealt in turn to every enemy in range for wider coverage, but each single target gets a smaller share than Cluster.
Beyond this distance the user closes in instead of firing. Larger values open from further.
On: an enemy with more enemies around it is preferred so the blast splashes a group; off: order it like a plain ranged attack, ignoring crowd density.
